The mobile layout applies up to 820px wide, so iPad portrait gets it and iPad landscape gets desktop. The breakpoint is set in code (docs/scripts/set-breakpoint.mjs), not here.

settings.label: Hover background
settings.info: Clear it to let the theme pick the hover colours automatically. Hover text is only used while this is set.

settings.label: Hover background
settings.info: Clear it to let the theme pick the hover colours automatically. Hover text is only used while this is set.

settings.info: t:info.checkout_buttons

settings.content: Coszus styling for Horizon's cart drawer (docs/HANDOFF.md section 3). Cart settings above still apply.

settings.label: Close the bag after adding
settings.info: When Add to bag opens it. 0 keeps it open. It stays open once the shopper hovers, touches, scrolls or presses a key in it.

settings.label: Show free delivery bar
settings.info: Only shown to UK visitors paying in pounds.

settings.label: Free delivery over (£)
settings.info: Match the free shipping rate in Settings > Shipping and delivery. The bar can't read it.

settings.label: Text when the bag is empty
settings.default: Free UK delivery on orders over [amount]

settings.label: Text below the threshold
settings.default: You're [amount] away from free UK delivery
settings.info: [amount] is what's left to spend.

settings.label: Sale tag
settings.info: On sale items: products in the Sale collections (Theme settings > Product cards), or anything with a compare-at price when none are picked. Empty hides it.

settings.label: Set tag
settings.info: On both pieces when a product and its Set partner (custom.set_partner) are both in the bag. "Complete the set" is kept for the add-ons that suggest the missing piece.

settings.label: Use the store's Upsell fields
settings.info: Until Set partners are filled in, shows products from Cart Product Upsell and Upsell Products, titled "Goes well with". They're not sets, so they never say "Complete the set".

settings.label: Otherwise, add-ons from
settings.info: Used when nothing in the bag has a Set partner or Upsell. Titled "Add £X for free delivery" below the threshold, otherwise "Goes well with".

settings.label: Savings tag
settings.info: Shown when items are on sale or discounted.

settings.label: Show Coszus Rewards line
settings.info: Uses Points per £1 in Theme settings > Coszus Rewards.

settings.label: Clearpay text
settings.default: Or 4 interest-free payments of [amount] with Clearpay

settings.label: Clearpay order limit (£)
settings.info: Hidden above this. Check the limit in your Clearpay account.

settings.label: Show rating
settings.info: Off until there's a real score. Needs the rating text and a link to the live score too.

settings.label: Rating title
settings.info: E.g. Excellent. Only if the linked page says it.

settings.label: Rating text
settings.info: E.g. Rated 4.8/5. Must match the live score on the linked page. Blank hides the rating.

settings.label: Rating link
settings.info: The page showing the live score. Without it the rating stays hidden.

settings.label: Returns, international
settings.info: For visitors outside the UK. Delivery line is hidden for them. Empty hides this line too.

settings.label: Buttons
settings.info: One per department in Theme settings > Departments.

settings.content: Shared by the bag drawer, the product page, the account page and the Coszus Rewards page. Match it to Smile.

settings.label: Points per £1
settings.info: Points are worked out on the price after discounts, rounded down.

settings.label: Points per reward
settings.info: What one reward costs in Smile (100 points = £5 off).

settings.label: Reward value (£)
settings.info: What that reward is worth. With Points per reward, this works out the Account page card's progress bar and "points until your next £5 off" line.

settings.content: The nav coin and the Coszus Rewards page open Smile's own panel. The Account card shows the real balance once the JavaScript SDK is on in Smile Admin > Settings > Developer Tools. Smile's floating launcher is switched off in Smile Admin, not here.
Links used by the bag's empty state and the search panel's Shop list. The header has its own department settings.

settings.label: Sale collection
settings.info: Shown in Rouge in the search panel. Not used in the empty bag.

settings.content: One switch for the Black Friday extras: the Black Friday page, the sale page titles, chips and lines, the menu links, two top bar messages and the hero slide marked Black Friday. Nothing shows on the site until this is on AND the start time has passed. Untick it to take everything down at once. Rename the sale (Christmas Sale, New Year Sale) with the text settings below; no links change.

settings.label: Starts (UK time)
settings.info: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM in UK time, for example 2026-11-16 00:00. Checked in each visitor's browser as the page loads, so cached pages switch on time too.

settings.label: Preview in the theme editor
settings.info: Shows everything as if it's live, in the theme editor only, even before the start time and with the switch off. Untick to see the site as visitors do now.

settings.label: Sale name
settings.info: The menu link, the sale page titles and the page heading.

settings.label: Short line
settings.info: First top bar message, the line on the top tile of the Black Friday page and the small line above Men, Women and Juniors on the sale pages.

settings.label: Top bar message colour
settings.info: The two Black Friday messages in the top bar. White reads best on the black bar.

settings.label: Line under the sale page title
settings.default: Spend £100, get a free tote or trek hat

settings.content: The sale pages that get the title, lines and chips, and where the menu and the Black Friday page tiles link to.

settings.label: Juniors sale
settings.info: Blank uses the Juniors Sale collection (handle juniors-sale) once it exists.

settings.label: Sale page chips
settings.default:
Hoodies: Hoodie
Tracksuits: filter.p.m.custom.tracksuit_piece=1
Jackets: Jacket, Windbreaker
Bottoms: Jogger
Tops: T-shirt, Top
Denim: Jeans, Cargos
Shorts: Shorts
Sets: Set
Headwear: Headwear
Accessories: Socks, Underwear, Bag, Accessories
settings.info: One chip per line: the label, a colon, then the product types it shows (as in Products > Product type), separated by commas. A chip only shows when that sale has products of those types. A value with = in it is a Search & Discovery filter instead, like the Tracksuits line, which needs the tracksuit_piece filter switched on.

settings.label: Blend white images into the background
settings.info: Uses multiply blending, so flat lays shot on white sit on the image background.

settings.label: Show Sale tag on cards
settings.info: Off by default: sale items show the old price struck through instead.

settings.content: Sale collections: only products in one of these get a Sale tag (on cards, and in the bag). None picked: anything with a compare-at price does. The struck-through old price always shows.

settings.label: Low stock tag at or under
settings.info: Red "Low stock" tag when a product's total stock (all sizes) is this low. Only for products whose stock Shopify tracks. 0 turns it off.

settings.label: "New" tag for products published in the last (days)
settings.info: The product tag "new" or the Badge metafield (custom.badge) also set the tag. Never shown on sale items. 0 turns the automatic tag off.

settings.label: Show Best Seller tag on cards
settings.info: Small grey "Best Seller" tag. New, Low stock and Sold out win if a product has more than one.

settings.label: Best Seller collection 1
settings.info: Every product in this collection gets the tag. The product tag "best-seller" also adds it.

settings.label: Show wishlist bookmarks
settings.info: Bookmark on Coszus product cards and next to Add to bag, plus the header and account links. Off at launch until the Coszus app wishlist can share the same list. Saved products show on the page using the Wishlist template.

settings.label: Account wishlist endpoint
settings.info: Empty: saved products stay in the visitor's browser. Enter /apps/wishlist once the wishlist app is set up (docs/WISHLIST-APP.md) so signed-in customers' lists follow them between devices.

settings.label: Ask guests to join after their first save
settings.info: Shows the Join the Family panel once, after a guest's first save. Never to signed-in customers, or again once they join or tap Not now. Copy: Join the Family settings.

settings.content: Stars per product, read from the reviews.rating and reviews.rating_count metafields that Judge.me and most review apps fill in. Products with no reviews show nothing. There's no site-wide score.

settings.label: Show stars on product cards
settings.info: Small stars and the review count under the price.

settings.label: Show stars on the product page
settings.info: Stars and the review count under the product name. Also adds the rating to the product's Google structured data, so turning this off removes that too.

settings.content: One sign-up used in the footer, the wishlist panel and the Coszus Rewards page. Sign-ups are Shopify customers with email marketing on, tagged newsletter, source:footer / source:wishlist / source:rewards and shopping-for:men / women / juniors for Omnisend.

settings.label: Wishlist panel heading
settings.info: Shown with the product they just saved. The Points page panel and the footer use the heading above.

settings.content: Three rows under the heading, each an icon, a bold label and a short line. Leave a label empty to hide that row.

settings.label: Perk 1 label
settings.info: Gift icon.

settings.label: Perk 1 small print
settings.info: A line under perk 1.
settings.default: 10% off full-price items on your first order.

settings.label: Perk 2 label
settings.info: Star icon.

settings.label: Perk 3 label
settings.info: Bookmark icon. Only shows while Wishlist › Show wishlist bookmarks is on.

settings.label: Shopping-for note
settings.info: Small grey text after the question, e.g. (optional). Empty shows nothing.

settings.label: Shopping-for options
settings.info: Separate with commas. Saved as tags: shopping-for:men. Empty hides the question.

settings.label: Small print
settings.default: You'll get emails from Coszus. Unsubscribe any time.

settings.label: Go straight to sign-in
settings.info: Off (recommended): they see the thank-you below and stay on the site. On: opens Shopify's sign-in with their email filled in (they need an email code), then brings them back signed in.

settings.label: Thank-you
settings.default: You're in. Check your email for 10% off.

settings.label: Thank-you button
settings.default: Sign in to collect points and keep your saves

settings.label: t:settings.empty_state_collection
settings.info: t:settings.empty_state_collection_info

settings.label: Rotating placeholder
settings.info: Separate with |. The first one stays put for reduced motion.

settings.label: Shop heading
settings.info: Links come from Theme settings > Departments.

settings.label: Popular searches
settings.default: Tracksuits, Hoodies, MotoX, Shorts, Gothic, Denim
settings.info: Separate with commas. Each one runs a search.

settings.label: Recent heading
settings.info: Recent searches are kept on the shopper's device only.

settings.label: Show "Showing results for"
settings.info: When the typed word isn't in any result but Shopify suggests a close spelling.

settings.label: Heading above products when nothing matches
settings.info: Products from the empty state collection above.

settings.label: New In collection
settings.info: "No results" shows links to New In, Men, Women and Juniors, in the panel and on the results page. Men, Women and Juniors come from Theme settings > Departments.

settings.label: Show collections, pages and articles
settings.info: Off keeps the panel to suggestions and products, as in the design.
